content:
My Core One (Gen 1) was running 8.0.0 released Oct 22. It's the same firmware was INDX so it didn't update.

Another user commented that they forced the firmware install via PrusaConnect. That worked for me.

replies.content:
To re-flash the firmware:
Push the reset button, and once the printer logo appears on the screen, press the display knob once.
On the new screen, confirm the update by selecting the "FLASH" button and pressing the display knob.

content:
Echoing E_Str8.  Between the time I received my INDX kit and the time I finished assembly, there was a new firmware version available.

So don't skip this step.
Do not skip this even if your Core One was already up to date. INDX firmware is not the same as non-INDX firmware.
